findingVerification.notes: The benchmark warden.toml explicitly sets defaults.verification.enabled = true.

traceCapture.notes: Run used --traces on six final shards. Two shards use combined-clean artifacts after targeted parallelism-1 repairs. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review; committed traceSummaries retain sanitized per-chunk metadata only.

timing.notes: Total wall time and cost include targeted repair runs. Final per-chunk timing uses the selected clean records.

scoring.notes: Agent-verified semantic matches. A finding counts when it identifies the same bug in roughly the same location at the same corpus commit. Same-file findings about different bugs do not count; one finding can map to multiple corpus IDs.
